process_steps.input_state: elemental powders of Mo, Si, B

evidence.quote: Powder blending was conducted for 16 h using ethanol solution as media.
The slurry was dried and then subjected to preparatory consolidation under 300 MPa into platelets of 36 × 18 × 12 mm3.

The temperature was initially raised to 1400 °C during 3 h in vacuum. The soaking time at this temperature was 2 h without applied pressure. The temperature was then raised to 1600 °C during 1 h while a pressure of 20 MPa was applied to the compact with a soaking time of 2 h.
